extensions.name: Archive Audio (CC & Public Domain)
extensions.author: afrolord892-ai
extensions.description: Finds exact-duration audio recordings in the Internet Archive and offers only items carrying an explicit Public Domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA license. Supports streaming and offline audio downloads.

actions.name: audio.source
actions.why: Stream an exact-match recording with an explicit permissive license

actions.name: download.source
actions.why: Offer offline copies only when the item declares a permissive license

actions.name: network
actions.why: Search licensed Internet Archive audio and read its item metadata

extensions.changelog: First release. Audio streaming and downloads are limited to exact-duration items with a verified Public Domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA license URL.

extensions.name: LRCLIB Synced Lyrics
extensions.author: afrolord892-ai
extensions.description: Fetches line-synchronised lyrics from LRCLIB, checks artist, title and duration, and falls back to plain lyrics only when enabled.

actions.name: lyrics.provide
actions.why: Find timed or plain lyrics for the current song

actions.name: network
actions.why: Request lyrics and verify the matching track metadata

actions.name: settings.page
actions.why: Choose whether unsynchronised lyrics are shown

extensions.changelog: First release. Exact-match lookup first, strict fallback matching second, with LRC timestamps converted to Myspoti milliseconds.

extensions.name: MusicBrainz Track Details
extensions.author: afrolord892-ai
extensions.description: Adds a verified MusicBrainz recording match, release date, ISRC and recording identifier beneath the current track details.

actions.name: trackinfo.provide
actions.why: Show recording identifiers and release metadata

actions.name: network
actions.why: Look up the current recording in MusicBrainz

extensions.changelog: First release. One-request recording lookup with exact title and primary-artist matching and a one-request-per-second client throttle.
